arguments.sql:
WITH eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM main.account AS a
    JOIN main.district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 250000
      AND a.account_id IN (
          SELECT dp.account_id
          FROM main.disp AS dp
          JOIN main.card AS c ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
          WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND c.type = 'gold'
      )
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible_accounts) AS eligible_accounts,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.district AS d
     WHERE d.A4 = '' OR d.A4 GLOB '*[^0-9]*') AS nonnumeric_populations,
    MIN(t.date) AS first_debit_date,
    MAX(t.date) AS last_debit_date,
    COUNT(*) AS debit_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN t.bank IS NULL OR t.account IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing_recipient_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN t.bank = '' THEN 1 END) AS empty_bank_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN t.account = 0 THEN 1 END) AS zero_account_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(t.amount) = 'real' THEN 1 END) AS real_amount_rows,
    MIN(t.amount) AS minimum_debit_amount
FROM main.trans AS t
JOIN eligible_accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM main.account AS a
    JOIN main.district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 250000
      AND a.account_id IN (
          SELECT dp.account_id
          FROM main.disp AS dp
          JOIN main.card AS c ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
          WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND c.type = 'gold'
      )
)
SELECT t.operation,
       COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN t.bank IS NULL AND t.account IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS both_missing,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN t.bank IS NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS bank_missing,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS account_missing,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account = 0 THEN 1 END) AS bank_with_zero_account,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL
                           THEN t.bank || ':' || t.account END) AS recipient_pairs
FROM main.trans AS t
JOIN eligible_accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
GROUP BY t.operation

arguments.sql:
SELECT t.bank AS recipient_bank_code,
       t.account AS recipient_counter_account,
       COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payment_count,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
FROM main.trans AS t
JOIN main.account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN main.district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
  AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 250000
  AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
  AND t.account IS NOT NULL
  AND a.account_id IN (
      SELECT dp.account_id
      FROM main.disp AS dp
      JOIN main.card AS c ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
      WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER'
        AND c.type = 'gold'
  )
GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC, t.bank, t.account
LIMIT -1
